note: Show names match music/<show>/ and drops/today/<show>/. Weekdays run by time of day; the weekend runs by genre, Friday 17:00 through Sunday 22:00. Nights carry past midnight — Friday night is Saturday 1am.

firstlight.vibe: Soft, slow, nothing demanding. Music for opening the laptop and deciding what the day is.

slowroll.vibe: Warmer and jazzier. Properly awake now, still unhurried.

midday.vibe: Brighter and easy. Lunch music — present but not distracting.

longafternoon.vibe: Focus music. Minimal, low drama, long tracks. The hardest hours of the day.

slowdrive.vibe: Rush hour. Steady, calm, get-home-safe. Nothing jarring, nothing that makes anyone drive faster.

nightgarage.vibe: Deeper, groove-led. House and garage. The evening has some energy in it.

smallhours.vibe: Sparse and ambient. Long pads, almost no percussion. Company for anyone still up.

afrofriday.vibe: Afrobeats, all night. Friday clocks off and the weekend starts here.

saturdaysoul.vibe: R&B and soul. Easy start, nobody's in a hurry.

hiphop.vibe: Hip hop through the afternoon. Confident, head-nod tempo.

trap.vibe: Harder and darker. The night getting its shoes on.

househours.vibe: House. The peak of the weekend, straight through to sunrise.

sundayfolk.vibe: Folk and acoustic. Gentle, warm, unhurried.

country.vibe: Country and americana. Sunday afternoon, windows open.

any.vibe: Catch-all. Tracks that suit the station at any hour, played whenever a show folder is empty.
